## Meridian Tidal Pilot - Summary

The main equipment failure was **Turbine T-4**, which suffered a bearing seal corrosion on 14 March 2025, allowing seawater into the nacelle and causing a multi-week outage; the root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing.

Over the full 24-month operating period the pilot delivered **18.7 GWh** to the grid, which was 6% below the forecasted 19.9 GWh.

The project came in at **EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million**, representing a 12.4% overrun (EUR 4.55M), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

Environmental monitoring found **no statistically significant change** in fish migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41) according to the independent fish-monitoring programme.

Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended **replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles**, a change the steering group accepted in principle.

The final decision: **the steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on a completed redesign of the bearing seal and a successful dry-dock endurance test**.
